changelog: Shotgun MAGs: 2.20.4 stopped at the end of the MAG step ("'PosixPath' object has no attribute 'get'") whenever the GTDB database was installed — the GTDB step reused the name of the joined-bins table. Fixed, and the whole MAG step (split, join, GTDB, AMRFinderPlus, bin table) is now run end to end with stand-in tools before release. The profile and resistome were never affected.

previous.changelog: Shotgun MAGs, from the Zymo Nanopore run: (1) Nanopore contigs are polished with Medaka (the WGS tool, bacterial model when the reads allow) before binning — unpolished contigs carry indels that break genes, and CheckM2 called near-whole genomes 40-70 % complete (B. subtilis 3.9 Mb in 2 contigs: 58 %). (2) Pieces of one genome are joined: bins of the same Kraken 2 species at similar depth (within 1.5x) are merged when CheckM2 finds the result >= 10 points more complete and still < 10 % contaminated (E. faecalis came out as 45 % + 39 %, L. fermentum as 46 % + 19 %). Joined bins are marked in the report (double dagger) and mags_summary.csv (merged_from). Includes 2.20.3 (mixed bins split by contig taxonomy).
